tasks.title: Add bearer-token authentication middleware over the /api surface

When REDDY_API_TOKEN is set, every request must carry Authorization: Bearer <token> or x-reddy-token: <token>, compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual; otherwise 401 {error:'UNAUTHORIZED'}. The test helper injects the token into the child env and into outgoing fetch calls so the existing 57 tests keep asserting the same behaviours.
